FX-GRADE-001.says: Every setting as added, no look: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE-002.says: Temperature 60: warmer, red up and blue down in linear light, white's brightness kept, so white itself turns cream with its red held at 1.

FX-GRADE-003.says: Temperature -60, tint 40: cooler and toward magenta.

FX-GRADE-004.says: Exposure 1: one stop brighter in linear light, the brightest colours held at white.

FX-GRADE-005.says: Exposure -1.5: a stop and a half darker.

FX-GRADE-006.says: Contrast 80: darks darker, lights lighter, middle grey and the pure colours' 0 and 1 kept.

FX-GRADE-007.says: Contrast -60: flatter, everything toward the middle.

FX-GRADE-008.says: Highlights -70, shadows 70: the lights brought down and the darks opened up, black and white kept.

FX-GRADE-009.says: Whites 50, blacks -50: white past 1 and held, black below 0 and held, more contrast at the ends.

FX-GRADE-010.says: Whites -60, blacks 60: white lowered and black lifted, a faded picture.

FX-GRADE-011.says: Saturation 0: every colour its own grey, L of its encoded colour.

FX-GRADE-012.says: Saturation 160: stronger colours, the pure ones already at the edge held there.

FX-GRADE-013.says: The look at intensity 100: the look file's table as Color Lookup reads it.

FX-GRADE-014.says: The look at intensity 50: halfway from the drawing to the look.

FX-GRADE-015.says: The look at intensity 200: the look's change doubled, held inside 0 to 1.

FX-GRADE-016.says: The look named, intensity 0: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-GRADE-017.says: Faded film 70: black lifted to about 0.18 and white lowered to 0.93, a washed-out print.

FX-GRADE-018.says: Vibrance 80: the dull colours (skin, the warm tones) strengthened more than the strong ones; greys unchanged.

FX-GRADE-020.says: Shadow tint hue 195 at 60, highlight tint hue 35 at 50: teal shadows, orange highlights, middle grey untouched.

FX-GRADE-021.says: The same with tint balance 60: the shadows' tint weaker, the highlights' stronger.

FX-GRADE-022.says: Vignette -3, midpoint 50, roundness 0, feather 50: the corners darkened toward black by 60 per cent, the middle untouched.

FX-GRADE-023.says: Vignette 2, midpoint 20, roundness 100, feather 10: a round, firm white edge.

FX-GRADE-024.says: A whole grade: white balance, exposure, the tone sliders, saturation, the look at 80, faded film, vibrance, teal and orange tints and a dark vignette, each step in its order.

FX-GRADE-025.says: Exposure keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 one stop up, frame 4 two.

FX-GRADE-026.says: Contrast 50 and vignette -4 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the vignette goes with the layer.

FX-GRADE-027.says: Contrast 50 with the look naming the drawing, which is not a lookup file: drawn with the contrast and without the look, with a warning on opening and on each frame.

FX-GRADE-028.says: Temperature 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-029.says: Exposure -5.5, below -5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-030.says: Saturation 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-031.says: Look intensity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-032.says: Shadow tint hue 361, past a full turn. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-033.says: Vignette amount 5.5, above 5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-GRADE-034.says: Vignette roundness -20: Lumetri's squarer vignette, below 0, which this effect does not draw (a gap). The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
